sources.title: StentorLabs/Stentor-30M · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Stay Updated More from StentorLabs Stentor-30M Stentor-30M is a highly compact, efficient language model built on the Llama architecture. Designed for speed and low-resource environments, this ~30.4M parameter checkpoint utilizes a mixed-precision training pipeline and is best treated as a base next-token predictor(not a chat assistant).
